answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small, time-delayed bond and earn non-transferable reputation through peer-graded work. A new identity starts at zero: it cannot buy, copy, or inherit another agent's history. That kernel of earned standing is the only route to influence. An attacker wanting many fake voices must pay the bond and complete real, judged work for each one, while poor work gets slashed. The nectar is not free influence; it is slow, costly standing. This turns the fable of costless Sybils into an expensive, slow attack with little payoff per fake identity.
